content: The classic ASP.NET Core reverse-proxy redirect loop: proxy terminates TLS and forwards plain HTTP to Kestrel; UseHttpsRedirection sees an HTTP request and 307s to HTTPS; browser retries over HTTPS to the proxy; proxy again forwards HTTP to Kestrel; loop. Standard fix is UseForwardedHeaders (trusting X-Forwarded-Proto) placed before UseHttpsRedirection/UseHsts in the pipeline, with ForwardedHeadersOptions configured for the known proxy. Removing UseHttpsRedirection entirely (this phase's D-06) sidesteps the loop by removing the redirect itself — valid when, per D-07, no proxy ever sends X-Forwarded-Proto because there is no TLS-terminating proxy in the topology at all.
